description_md: CalCOFI grid cell; FK to `grid`. Derived via `assign_grid_key()`.

Cruise natural key (YYYY-MM-NODC); FK to `cruise`. Resolved by `resolve_cruise_key()` from `ship_key` and `cruise_ym` by date span, then the source designation, then the month; a bin whose ship has no match stays NULL (question Q07).
Which `resolve_cruise_key()` step resolved the key: `span`, `source` or `month`.
2-letter suffix of the provider cruise code (e.g. `SR` from `2411SR`); join to `ship$ship_key`.
Source designation `20` + the first four characters of the provider cruise code (e.g. `202411`).
CalCOFI station key 'LLL.L SSS.S', derived as `sprintf('%05.1f %05.1f', line, station)` from the source's own Line/Station columns.
UTC start of the IFCB run, parsed from the bin id `DYYYYMMDDTHHMMSS_IFCBnnn` and checked against the provider's Pacific `Sample_time_PT`.
Sampled bottle depth; equal to `depth_max_m` (a bottle sample has no depth span).
`taxa` verbatim, except `unidentified cells` -> `unidentified_cells` (no space in the dataset-local `taxon_key`).
Images (cells) per ml analysed, summed over the four ESD size classes.
`sum(n_cells x mean biovolume) / volume analysed`, over the four size classes.
